description: Return all memories currently in the focus buffer (0-3) with full content. These are the memories pinned for guaranteed prompt context inclusion. Returns an envelope object with 'memories' (the focused memory records) and 'count'.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Envelope with the memories currently pinned in the focus buffer ('memories' list) and their 'count'
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Determine the appropriate next action based on the context and action result.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Retrieving memories from the focus buffer
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: DatabaseError: failed to query focus buffer.
